title: Distribution of the Land and Holy Offerings
description: God gives detailed instructions through Ezekiel on how the land is to be distributed: a holy district is set apart for the priests and Levites, a portion for the city, and land on both sides for the prince. The people are to use correct weights and measures, and the prince shall receive gifts of wheat, barley, oil, and livestock. The chapter concludes with regulations for cleansing the sanctuary, celebrating Passover, and the festival in the seventh month, including offering gifts that the prince must present to make atonement for the house of Israel.
